eng: Veikkaus Oy
Detection and response technology and services

Veikkaus is initiating a tendering process for modern security services and related technology components to strengthen and evolve its security operations capabilities. Veikkaus seeks managed Detection and Response services on top of cloud-native, scalable, and automation-driven solutions that utilize Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to enable continuous advancement of security operations. The goal is to achieve proactive, data-driven protection and improved operational efficiency across all business environments – both on-premises and in our multicloud-cloud setup. Veikkaus requires the signing of a non-disclosure agreement in order for the tenderers to gain full access to the documents attached to the request for tenders (Annex 8 Integrations & Annex 12 Log Sources). Tenderers must send the signed non-disclosure agreement (Annex 13) to: hankinnat@veikkaus.fi . After submission, Veikkaus will provide the confidential materials to the tenderer who has signed the agreement.
The tenderer is registered in the relevant trade registers kept by the Member State of establishment.
Price
Quality

Price: 282 total points The cheapest offer gets full points according to the weight value, and the points of others are proportional to the offer of the lowest tenderer using the formula: (minimum given value / offered value) * maximum points

Quality: 188 total points, divided into sections: Service Requirements total 30 points Technology Requirements total 20 points Integrations total 6 points Preliminary Project Plan total 60 points Key Personel Interview total 72 points Quality points will not be scaled or normalised. Each Tenderer will receive exactly the number of quality points earned on the basis of its responses, in accordance with the scoring rules described in the procurement documents.

Sähkötarvikkeet

TeeSe Botnia Oy Ab pyytää tarjouksia sähkötarvikkeista TeeSe Botnia Oy:n ja sen omistajayhteisöjen tarpeisiin. Tavoitteena on sähkötarvikkeita koskevan puitejärjestelyn muodostaminen useamman toimittajan kanssa 15.6.2026 (tavoite) alkavalle toistaiseksi voimassa olevalle sopimuskaudelle. Hankinnan kohteena ovat sähkötarvikkeiden toimitus- ja noutomyynti. Tuotteet noudetaan suoraan tarjoajan myymälästä ja/tai noutopisteesta, tai toimitetaan tilaajan osoittamaan osoitteeseen. Sopimuskauden aikana tilaaja voi tilata hankinnan kohteen mukaisia tuotteita tarjotuilla yksikköhinnoilla (netto), alennusprosentilla (tarjouspyynnön hintaliitteen ulkopuoliset tuotteet) tai minikilpailuttamalla. Solmittavan puitejärjestelyn perusteella sopimuksen käyttäjäyhteisöillä on oikeus ostaa sopimustoimittajalta myös muita tuotealueen aihepiiriin sisältyviä tuotteita ja lisäpalveluita, joita ei ole erikseen yksilöity ja nimetty puitesopimuksessa tai tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Puitejärjestelyyn valitaan kolme (3) toimittajaa riittävän tuotevalikoiman takaamiseksi, ellei hyväksyttäviä tarjouksia ole tätä vähemmän.

The purpose of this Contract Notice is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a 3-year period will be selected. Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. Applications will be accepted throughout the lifecycle of the Panel at any stage, however in order to be considered for the first tranche of contracts, applicants should apply by 1st June 2026. The existing Framework Agreement will expire on the 31st July 2026, and will be replaced by this Panel which will operate from 1st August 2026 for a period of 3 years.
